change: Four walk-note fixes after bathrooms TRIAL 1 (user: 'good starting point, but things to work out'). (1) HALL BATH DOORWAY (06:49 'what's with this wall blocking the doorway?'): hifi_bathrooms.py cut the subway-tile wainscot only at the openings' casing pieces, so the tile, liner and cap ran straight across the door between its casing legs (x 8.511-8.526, z 10.274-10.949, 0.14-1.155 high) and across the window's reveal between its stool (0.81) and the cap; the cut list now includes every opening's void (lo..hi, sill or floor..head, through the wall's header box). New build gate 'Opening clear check' (SpecGreybox.OpeningFaces.cs): rays through every door/arch passage (0.4 m either side) and window reveal against every visible mesh; it fails the old build on exactly these two (BA_Subway 60 + 21 rays). (2) PARENTS' ENSUITE (06:50 'barely room to walk between the toilet and cabinets to exit'): the pinch was the open door leaf: hung on the BEDROOM face it stopped at 85 deg with its tip 0.28 m from the vanity's door-end corner. Re-hung on the bath face (the face it swings toward; frame x 3.005-3.065, mirrored, hinge still on the toilet side), opened to 125 deg (rests 0.1 m off the toilet), and the toilet moved 0.20 m toward its wall stub (z 2.98 -> 2.78; Marina 222's tank ruler: centre 0.38-0.40 m off the stub). Lane past the leaf tip 0.28 -> 0.70 m; toilet side to vanity front 0.62 -> 0.84 m. The vanity is unchanged (0.545 + 2 cm nosing: Marina 225's counter end reads >= 0.6 on the 2-gang switch plate; standard 21-22 in + nosing): it is not oversized. Kevin's knee space unchanged. (3) KITCHEN HUTCH (22:20 'supposed to be recessed into the wall like a built in a little bit'): film 2104 is shot from the hutch's left, where a freestanding case shows its end; the frame shows none (wallpaper meets the cases' left edges, which line up). Recess formed on the kitchen side: papered returns from the dining doors' casings to the cases and a papered head over the cases (up to the room top 2.438), 4 cm proud of the lower case (recess 0.49 m); no wall moved. (4) EXTERIOR SNOW (22:22 'why the weird gap in the snow'): the GLB rear slab object251 stops 5-15 cm short of Grade_RearW's edge (spec z 3.10; probe rays at x -10.5..-18 hit nothing there), so RearW's 0.30 m side face showed; a seam strip Grade_RearW_Seam (spec x -21.85..-9.642, z 3.05-3.45) 1 cm over both closes it. TRIAL.
